name: Amplify
description: Output +50%, added where this card sits in the chain.

name: Split
description: Fires 3 copies. Each copy deals 35% less.

name: Echo
description: Repeats everything to its LEFT once, 0.2s later, at 70% output. Put it last for the strongest copy.

name: Accelerate
description: This row fires 30% more often.

name: Enlarge
description: Radius +60%. Bursts, fields, mines, vortices and shoves only.

name: Pierce
description: Projectiles pass through 2 more enemies before stopping. Projectiles only.

name: Ricochet
description: Projectiles bounce once to a new target after hitting. Projectiles only.

name: Focus
description: Copy count set to 1. Output +120%. Placed BEFORE Split, both apply: 1 copy becomes 3 at the higher output.

name: Sustain
description: Duration +80%. Fields, mines, orbitals, vortices and buffs only.

name: Leech
description: You heal 3% of the damage this row deals.

name: Volatile
description: Anything this row leaves behind detonates when its life ends, for 50% of its damage. Projectiles, fields, mines, orbitals, vortices, ruptures.

name: Quantize
description: This row fires only on the beat grid. Fires that land on the beat deal 25% more.

name: Overdrive
description: Output +100%. Each fire adds 1.5 Heat, ignoring the Cycle budget.

name: Resonate
description: This row also fires whenever the row directly above it fires.

name: Ground
description: The row directly above costs 30% fewer Cycles. This row deals 20% less.

name: Fork
description: Chain jumps +2. Output -20%. Chains only (Arc).

name: Conduct
description: Range +80%. Projectile flight distance, beam length and chain jump distance.

name: Seeker
description: Projectiles steer toward their target. Projectile speed -25%. Projectiles only.

name: Slug
description: Projectile speed -50%. Output +90%. Projectiles only.

name: Bloom
description: Area effects detonate a second time 0.16s later, at 40% damage and 70% radius. Bursts, fields, mines and shoves.

name: Insulate
description: This row produces no Heat at all. Output -25%.

name: Grounding Rod
description: Events from this row are treated as cascade depth 0: no depth output penalty, and no Heat from depth. Everything it triggers starts a fresh chain.

name: Stagger
description: Everything this row does happens 0.35s later.

name: Mirror
description: This row uses the Action of the row above it. Its own Action is ignored.

name: Governor
description: This row costs half its Cycles. Its output multiplier is capped at 2x.
